text:
raya (product): dropping a short sync note 00: we need alignment on the region-lock pilot scope before Q3 planning.

ben (eng): main tech asks from eng: clear failover semantics, eviction strategy for cross-region caches, and CI tests.

kai (infra): infra constraints: limited inter-region bandwidth for cross-region rehydrate, egress billing spike risk. we should cap cross-region replication during pilot.

nora (arch): proposed launch checklist (short):
- policy DSL v0 with template precedence defined
- soft-lock routing mode implemented (warn header + analytics)
- canary migration runbook and rollback steps
- console telemetry: per-tenant latency, residency-breaches, and egress

ben (eng): numbers request: can we aim for p95 regional < 180ms, p99 < 320ms, target error < 0.4%? otherwise sales will push back.

raya (product): GTM asked for a 10-week pilot window for one anchor customer (Horizon). Is that realistic?

kai (infra): 10w is tight but doable if pilot restricted to one region pair and we don't onboard new models. need a no-new-models clause.

lee (sales): legal insists on a residency enrollment process: customers must sign region-lock addendum. also they want a migration SLA appendix.

nora (arch): routing behavior thought: default = origin affinity, fallback = nearest healthy region. in soft-lock send X-Residency-Warning and metric for breach. hard-lock requires contract flag.

ben (eng): cache plan: consistent-hash sharding + async replica. add a rehydration job in infra to warm caches from snapshot before cutover.

kai (infra): will add an autoscaling window and pre-seed step to ops checklist. note: collecting per-tenant egress metrics will increase TSDB cardinality ~12-18%.

raya (product): action items:
- nora: full acceptance criteria doc by Thu EOD
- ben: CI tests (failover + cache rehydration) PR by next Tue
- kai: infra cost delta and ops checklist by Mon
- lee: draft contract appendix with legal by Fri

deploy-bot: pipeline: routing-dsl-canary build passed -> https://ci.internal/5678

lee (sales): also want migration runway language: how long we'll allow pre-cutover cross-region traffic and how we'll handle rollbacks.

raya (product): propose default soft-runway = 7 days for pilot, with telemetry review after 72h. exceptions per contract.

ben (eng): question: do we want to enforce request tagging for residency (app teams can surface)? telemetry relies on it.

nora (arch): yes, tag.request.residency should be supported. SDKs update can follow pilot.

kai (infra): ops note: set egress throttle at 80% of budget to avoid surprise charges.

raya (product): great. i'll update the public-facing doc and ping when acceptance criteria live. thanks all :rocket:
